positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Backend Engineer - NGINX SaaS on Azure
Working on bringing NGINX as a first party managed offering on Microsoft Azure.
positions.insights: Skills: Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Kubernetes · Go (Programming Language) · Apache Kafka · Microsoft Azure

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Backend Engineer - Subscriptions, Communities, Fleets, Core Data & Metrics
● Contributed to building the Subscription infrastructure to facilitate Twitter’s Paid Subscription offering.
Developed new features as part of premium offering - Verification, Edit tweets, Customizable Timelines,
Early access to experimental features.
● Developed features to improve subscriber retention and customer acquisition through onboarding NUX, targeted upsells and launching globally. 
● Contributed to core functionality needed to launch Twitter Communities allowing users to Tweet to a
dedicated space based on interest. Helped launch the product to GA.
● Developed core functionality needed to support Fleets(ephemeral Tweets) in AWS using Golang.
● Worked on serving recommended notifications to users when an in-network user creates a Fleet.
● Developed inline-reactions allowing users to engage with Fleets using emojis.
● Made improvements to the MAU/DAU data pipeline to improve accuracy and speed of processing.
● Improved accuracy of user segmentation model which is used to classify users into 7 distinct states based
on user activity.
● Worked on a scrubbing framework to remove personal data from datasets across Twitter for GDPR
compliance.
positions.insights: Skills: Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Google Cloud Platform (GCP) · Big Data · Go (Programming Language) · Apache Kafka · Airflow · Scala

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Game Developer for the popular pictionary game 'Draw Something'
- Developing core gameplay features including a new game mode, in-game achievements & UI in C++
- Added social features, including friends and chat
- Redesigned and redeveloped the entire game for cocos2d-x in C++
- Created tools and scripts for designers that streamline the content creation process in Ruby.

Game Developer for the casual arcade shooter game `Bubble Safari'
- Worked on the bold beat game-mechanic 'ConnectedWorld', aimed at integrating the web and mobile games

projects.title: Big Data Analytics for Sustainable Cities and Communities
projects.description:
Used Spark to analyze NYC cab and Airbnb housing data to figure out way to improve transportation and housing situation in New York City.
Applied spatial clustering to find areas lacking public transportation and affordable housing.

projects.title: Detecting and rectifying signs of nervousness in public speaking videos
